crossRefs.note: They answered, “We will willingly give them.” They spread a garment, and every man threw the earrings of his plunder…

translations.web: They answered, “We will willingly give them.” They spread a garment, and every man threw the earrings of his plunder into it.
translations.bsb: “We will give them gladly,” they replied. So they spread out a garment, and each man threw an earring from his plunder onto it.
translations.kjv: And they answered, We will willingly give them. And they spread a garment, and did cast therein every man the earrings of his prey.
translations.asv: And they answered, We will willingly give them. And they spread a garment, and did cast therein every man the ear-rings of his spoil.
